//identity: `slug` is the URL segment and the data directory name. It must never change
once published — every owner, player and matchup URL sits underneath it.
`features` gates whole subsystems: this league is redraft, so keepers, ADP
capture and the Keepers tab are all off.
name: Masterbatters Fantasy Football
//appsScript: One Apps Script web app fronts this league's Google Sheet, dispatching on a
`func` query parameter — the punishment tracker calls
URL here, with no query string; each caller appends its own.
Leave it empty and the tracker serves
path and badged as sample data.
Public by construction: a static site ships this URL in its JavaScript. Fine
for reads; the write endpoints will need a shared secret of their own.
//commissioner: Who may record that a punishment has been completed. Everyone can see the
ledger and anyone can spin a wheel, but marking somebody's punishment done
is a claim about the real world that one person should be making.
A slug rather than a flag, and config rather than a hardcoded name, because
this repo serves several leagues and the commissioner differs per league.
A person, not a team: a co-owner does not inherit it.
//discovery: Sleeper creates a NEW league_id every season and links it backward via
`previous_league_id`. There is no forward pointer, so the sync script finds
next year's league by listing `anchorUserId`'s leagues for that season and
picking the one whose previous_league_id matches the latest known season.
That also disambiguates from Den Ops, which the same anchor user plays in.
//owners: Sleeper is the only source this league has ever used, so there are no
Thomas Moore co-owns roster 10 with Robbie Goodman. Co-owners are
first-class: the team's record is credited to BOTH, so all-time columns
double-count that team-season. Intended — these are personal records.
Vance Armstrong played 2025 and is not in the 2026 league, so `active` is
false: they stay in all history but off current-season views.
Joe Gibbons joined for 2026, taking the spot Vance left. Listed here with no
seasons behind them, which `loadOwners` handles — every configured owner is
seeded whether or not they have played, so they can claim themselves in the
identity picker before their first game.
Note they are a DIFFERENT PERSON from Jake Gibbons; the shared surname is why
both slugs carry a first name.
